Package de.eldoria.eldoutilities.updater

Class UpdaterMessages

java.lang.Object
de.eldoria.eldoutilities.updater.UpdaterMessages
public final class UpdaterMessages extends Object
The texts the updater shows to players, as locale codes with English defaults.

With a localizer the codes are added to the plugin's locale files, so server owners can translate them and every player reads them in their own language. Plugins can ship translations for these codes in their bundled locale files. Without a localizer the English defaults are sent.

Texts use MiniMessage. Placeholders are tags: <plugin_name>, <new_version>, <current_version> and <website>, and for Lyna additionally <new_time>, <new_date_time>, <current_time> and <current_date_time>.

    • resolve

      public static String resolve(Plugin plugin, String text)
      The message to send for a text: the updater's codes become a locale tag when the plugin has a localizer and their English default otherwise. Any other text, including a plugin's own locale code, is returned as it is.

      text - locale code or text
      Returns:
